query: A Hedge on Demand Old Maud has heard about your hedge. "There's a gap in my fence the rabbits use, dearie," she says. "Grow me one there. Thorns on the outside, mind." The rabbits are watching from the cabbages. Grow it thorns and all The hedge comes up thick and thorny, and takes a strip off your knuckles on the way. Maud inspects it and says it'll do. The rabbits look betrayed. Grow it gently, for the cabbages You grow it soft and plant a row of cabbages beyond it for the rabbits. Maud laughs until she has to sit down. "You'll understand that in two weeks," she says.
